changelog.reason: Night sea shots lost separation from the sky; measured subject/background contrast was below 1.15x.
The moon and the wax seal needed more glow at 2.39:1; threshold raised from 0.72 to 0.76 to keep paper whites from blooming.
The mirror entrance needed an iris and the two impact moments needed a registered flash; both added to the art direction before implementation.
